subject: Sky Coin
text: The Sky Coin is gained after the defeat of Pazuzu, located in the red chest at the top of the tower.

evidence.quote:
*How do you get the Sky Coin?
This is gained after the defeat of Pazuzu- climb to the top of the tower and 
it is in the red chest.

subject: Focus Tower
text: You need the Sky Coin to gain access to the top of the Focus Tower.

evidence.quote:
*How do you get to the top of the Focus Tower?
You need the Sky Coin to gain access to the top of the Focus Tower.

subject: Giant Tree
text: To open the mouths of the trees in the Giant Tree, poke at them with your sword.

evidence.quote:
*Howdo you open the mouths of the trees in the Giant Tree?
All you need to do it poke at them with your sword.

subject: Foresta
text: There is a free bed in Foresta in the tree stump house on your right at the bottom, which is the left bed once inside.

evidence.quote:
*There is a free bed in Foresta in the tree stump house on your right at the 
bottom. Once inside it is the left bed.

subject: Dark King
text: A very easy way to kill the Dark King is to have Jason cast Cure on him, but do not have your companion do the same because they will undo the damage done by the hero.

evidence.quote:
*There is a very easy way to kill the Dark King (the end boss).  Just have 
Jason cast Cure on him.  But don't have your companion do the same.  Your 
companion will only undo the damage done by the hero.

subject: dead end
text: If you get to a dead end blocked by a chest, jump over the obstacle.

evidence.quote:
*One tip, if you get to a dead end (well, one blocked by a chest) just jump 
over the obstacle.

subject: instant death spells
text: Spells later in the game that monsters hit you with that can cause instant death if they connect are Corrode Gas, Doom Dance, and Doom Powder.

evidence.quote:
*There are certain spells later in the game that monsters hit you with that 
can cause instant death if they connect.  These spells are: Corrode Gas, Doom 
Dance,  and Doom Powder.

evidence.quote: *All Inns cost the same price to stay: 95 GP.

subject: Seeds
text: After clearing Mac's Ship, Seeds can be purchased in the lower levels of Mac's Ship for 50 GP for 1.

evidence.quote:
After clearing Mac's Ship, and preparing to fight through the Doom Castle, in 
the lower levels of Mac's Ship, you can purchase Seeds and Cure Potions!  
Seeds Cost 50 GP for 1 and Cure Potions cost 25 for 1.
